proofBoundary: Direct static proof for the pinned retail PC executable. This closes XAnim deltaPart pointer layout, 2D/3D time evaluation, terminal delta evaluation, key-index width selection, decoded translation interpolation, and loop-wrap relative-delta composition. It does not by itself prove how a model's ordinary animated root-bone translation track should be composed with bind pose; that remains a separate binding question.

referenceImplementations.note: Reference projects are used for structure/function naming only; promoted semantics are independently verified against the pinned retail executable bytes.

semantics.dispatch: weighted runtime path selects 2D evaluator when bDelta, otherwise 3D evaluator when bDelta3D
semantics.endOrZeroFramePath: time == 1.0 or numframes == 0 evaluates terminal/constant rotation and XAnim_CalcPosDeltaEntire
semantics.frameIndexWidth: numframes < 256 uses uint8 indices; numframes >= 256 uses uint16 indices
semantics.loopRange: higher-level relative-delta consumer evaluates start/end and, when bLoop and startTime > endTime, incorporates the full deltaPart across the wrap
semantics.rotation2D: deltaPart.quat2; null -> planar identity; size==0 -> constant signed-int16 pair; keyed -> component-wise linear interpolation in stored signed-int16 domain
semantics.rotation3D: deltaPart.quat; null -> quaternion identity; size==0 -> constant signed-int16 quaternion; keyed -> component-wise linear interpolation in stored signed-int16 domain
semantics.timeDomain: normalized animation time; retail evaluator has explicit time == 1.0 end/full-delta path
semantics.translation: null -> zero; size==0 -> constant vec3; keyed -> decode SMALL_TRANS/FULL_TRANS and linearly interpolate between surrounding keys
